displayName: Merged Pad Manual Stage Group Markers
description: Returns the individual manual annotation markers contained inside a selected manual stage group.
sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.annotation_id, a.layer_id, a.rule_concept_id, a.name AS well_name, a.stage_num, a.substage_name, a.start_time, a.end_time, COALESCE(a.timestamp, a.start_time) AS timestamp, a.start_feature, a.end_feature, a.selected_feature, a.annotation_type, a.labeler_id, a.notes, COALESCE(a.source_type, 'user') AS source_type, a.created_by_email, a.updated_by_email, true AS can_edit, COALESCE(a.status, 'active') AS status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS color FROM datastore:substage_annotations_v4 a WHERE COALESCE(a.status, 'active') = 'active' AND COALESCE(a.source_type, 'user') <> 'model' AND a.layer_id = CAST(:layer_id AS TEXT) AND a.name = CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) AND CAST(COALESCE(a.timestamp, a.start_time) AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(:start_time AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST(COALESCE(a.timestamp, a.start_time) AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(:end_time AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(a.timestamp, a.start_time) AS TIMESTAMP), a.annotation_id ) q
